meta.processing: closed boundary rings -> polygons; rings smaller than 0.00035 deg² dropped (largest ring per region always kept); Douglas-Peucker tolerance 0.004 deg; coordinates rounded to 3 decimals
meta.note: JMA tsunami FORECAST REGIONS (津波予報区), i.e. the areas a 津波警報/注意報 is issued for. Not a coastline. Not a tsunami inundation hazard zone. Modified from the source; see attribution.
meta.excluded: コード0（帰属未定1〜4）は識別子が存在しないため収録していません。
